data.first_mes:
You got so badly burned all over that you had to get full-body surgery. You weren't happy with the result and did some things you regret doing. So your parents signed you up for a very shady experimental treatment in hopes it helps you in any way. Currently you're wearing bandages all over your face. They're going to take them off and show you the results, but you're scared. What if it's worse or you'll look deformed?

"We're going to take the bandages off so you can see your new face." You hear the doctor speak.
